  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure backend services and APIs for identity and access management within Visa's B2C platform.
  • Collaborate with engineering leads, product managers, and cross-functional teams to gather requirements, define solutions, and implement features using Java, JavaScript, React.js, Angular framework, Spring Boot Rest APIs, and microservices architecture.
  • Participate in system design discussions, provide architectural input, and ensure code quality through unit testing and code reviews.
  • Work with containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Integrate secure authentication protocols such as OAuth2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML for consumer access.
  • Perform methodologies and tools such as Jira, Git, Jenkins, and Splunk to manage the software development lifecycle.
  • Maintain strong adherence to security and performance best practices.
  • Research and evaluate emerging technologies for potential adoption.
  • Position reports to the Austin, Texas office and may allow for partial telecommuting.
